sport.title: November 28, 1999: The day Pete Sampras won the ATP Finals for the fifth time
paras: On November 28, 1999, Pete Sampras beat Andre Agassi in the season-ending tennis finals. He won the event for the fifth time, matching Ivan Lendl’s record. Earlier in the same event, Agassi had beaten Sampras easily. But Sampras won their final match in three sets.

Sampras had missed two major tournaments that year because he was injured. He had also lost his place as the world’s top-ranked player. This victory gave him a strong finish to a difficult year. It also showed Agassi that Sampras could still challenge him in the biggest matches.
sport.curious: How did Sampras turn an earlier loss to Agassi into a final victory?
